skill: Sample statistics and margin of error
stem: A random sample of 400 seniors at one high school found a mean study time of 6.2 hours per week, with a margin of error of 0.5 hours. Which conclusion is most appropriate?
choices: It is plausible that the mean study time of all seniors at that school is between 5.7 and 6.7 hours per week.
The mean study time of all high school seniors in the country is between 5.7 and 6.7 hours per week.
Every senior at the school studies between 5.7 and 6.7 hours per week.
The mean study time of all seniors at the school is exactly 6.2 hours per week.
steps: The range is 6.2 ± 0.5, which is 5.7 to 6.7 hours.
The sample came from one school, so conclusions apply only to that school's seniors, not the whole country.
The margin of error describes the mean, not every individual student.
The true mean is estimated, not known exactly.
key: Generalize only to the population sampled, and only about the parameter estimated.
